facts.business: Shanti Guru Industries Limited (formerly RCL Retail Limited) is engaged in food-related business activities, as indicated by applicability of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and related regulations.
key_risks: Non-compliance with requirement of Woman Director under Section 149 of Companies Act, 2013 up to 25th August 2026
Non-compliance with composition of Audit Committee and Nomination & Remuneration Committee under Sections 177 and 178 up to 25th August 2026
Failure to maintain Structured Digital Database (SDD) as per Regulation 3(5) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
Non-disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 by promoter Mr. Sarthak Sanghvi
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions are in the ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis as per management representation.
